description: Generate complete documentation package for the Development Process Orchestrator (DPO) system based on all implemented components, testing results, and usage patterns

sections: High-level system overview and design principles
Available workflow templates and their use cases
Agent coordination patterns and best practices

documentation_standards.writing_style: clear, concise writing with practical examples

user_experience_focus: Getting started quickly with minimal setup
Effective usage patterns for common scenarios
ecosystem_integration: Links to related tools and capabilities

primary_documentation.DPO_USER_GUIDE.md: Complete user guide with installation, setup, CLI reference, workflows, and troubleshooting
primary_documentation.DPO_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md: Comprehensive system architecture documentation with design principles and component interactions
primary_documentation.DPO_DEVELOPER_REFERENCE.md: Developer documentation with API reference and extension guidelines
primary_documentation.DPO_CONFIGURATION_GUIDE.md: Configuration reference for system settings and customization
primary_documentation.DPO_TEMPLATE_LIBRARY.md: Template library documentation with workflows and customization guide

supporting_documentation.DPO_QUICK_START.md: Quick start guide for immediate setup and usage
supporting_documentation.DPO_API_SCHEMAS.md: API request/response schemas and validation rules

validation_requirements.content_accuracy: All technical information must be validated against current implementation
validation_requirements.example_testing: All code examples and configuration snippets must be tested
validation_requirements.cross_reference_validation: All internal links and references must be verified
validation_requirements.completeness_check: All components and features must be documented
validation_requirements.consistency_review: Documentation style and terminology must be consistent

execution_strategy.analysis_phase: Comprehensive code and existing documentation analysis

success_criteria: Complete documentation package with all required deliverables
Clear navigation and cross-referencing between documents
Practical examples and code samples for all major features
Ready for immediate use by developers and administrators
